hint_ladder: Say that something was moved to a later time.
Use put plus off; with a pronoun the object goes in the middle: put it off.
Start with the words: We had to put ___ the meeting until Friday.
teaching_content.reveal_form: We had to put off the meeting until Friday.
canonical_forms: We had to put off the meeting until Friday.
alternative_realizations: Don't put it off any longer.
